path: StarterPlayerScripts/PadFeedbackFx.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): For the visible buy pad, pulse a green Highlight or neon glow and its price tag while the owner's Cash >= cost, and stop it when not affordable or after a buy. Count it in a 'highlights' census counter. When a player touches a pad with too little cash, flash the pad red, play an error buzz and show a short 'Need $N' toast without deducting cash. Hook into UpgradeService and UpgradeFx, and increment a pad_denied counter. -- Client-only presentation. Waits for ReplicatedStorage 'PadFeedback'. Watches workspace descendants with attribute Affordable via GetAttributeChangedSignal, and while Affordable is true loops a tween that pulses the pad's neon glow (Material Neon, brightness via Color lerp toward green), its AffordHighlight FillTransparency (0.7 to 0.3) and its price-tag BillboardGui TextLabel (green text, slight size pulse). It restores the original Color/Material/text style when Affordable goes false. On the 'denied' message it flashes the pad red for about 0.4s then restores, and plays an error buzz using a verified sound id from GameAssets with a short Sound in SoundService. It sends nothing to the server. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: highlights, pad_denied.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets.luau, ReplicatedStorage/UiTheme.luau

```luau
--!strict
-- UiTheme: pure shared UI kit for the house Theme (no side effects, no server code).
-- Palette matches the HUD / cash look: yellow Primary, green Good, red Bad, blue Info, dark Ink outlines.
-- Telemetry (shop_opened, shop_purchases) is counted by the server-side owner of those events, not here.

local UiTheme = {}

-- Colors
UiTheme.ink = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.cream = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.panel = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.card = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UiTheme.text = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 41)
UiTheme.good = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92)
UiTheme.bad = Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
UiTheme.info = Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 255)
UiTheme.dim = Color3.fromRGB(190, 184, 176)
UiTheme.locked = Color3.fromRGB(120, 112, 134)

-- Fonts and metrics
UiTheme.font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
UiTheme.headerFont = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
UiTheme.cornerRadius = 14
UiTheme.stroke = 3
UiTheme.minButtonHeight = 48 -- at least 44 px touch target
UiTheme.padding = 10

-- Adds a UICorner to a GuiObject (reuses an existing one).
function UiTheme.roundify(guiObject: GuiObject, radius: number?)
	local corner = guiObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = guiObject
	end
	(corner :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or UiTheme.cornerRadius)
end

-- Returns a big readable TextButton.
-- props: text, size, position, anchorPoint, color, textColor, parent, name, zIndex, layoutOrder, onClick
function UiTheme.makeButton(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = props.name or "Button"
	button.Text = props.text or ""
	local size: UDim2 = props.size or UDim2.fromOffset(160, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	if size.Y.Offset < UiTheme.minButtonHeight and size.Y.Scale == 0 then
		size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	end
	button.Size = size
	button.Position = props.position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	button.AnchorPoint = props.anchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = props.color or UiTheme.accent
	button.TextColor3 = props.textColor or UiTheme.cream
	button.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.ZIndex = props.zIndex or 1
	button.LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 0

	UiTheme.roundify(button, UiTheme.cornerRadius)

	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	border.Color = UiTheme.ink
	border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	border.Parent = button

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	textStroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	textStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	textStroke.Parent = button

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.Parent = button

	local minSize = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	minSize.MinSize = Vector2.new(44, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	minSize.Parent = button

	local onClick = props.onClick
	if typeof(onClick) == "function" then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			onClick()
		end)
	end

	if props.parent then
		button.Parent = props.parent
	end
	return button
end

return UiTheme
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Do not give starting cash equal to the first upgrade's price. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally. They must still be easy to find and reach: guide the player to the first pad with a visible beam or arrow.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.
- Budget the whole first-payout path, not just the claim: claim delay + first spawn + conveyor travel (length / speed) should land the first cash-in within about 3-4s of the claim. Use a short, fast conveyor, spawn the first item immediately on claim, and don't leave this borderline.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance. Add a time-based fallback so a step can't stall. Make the steps lead the player to every key feature (buy pad, shop), and check that the guide beam or arrow actually appears (its census count is above 0). If the census shows beams = 0, the guide is invisible: fix the beam creation (attachments, parenting, target lookup), not just its config.
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound, FOV punch) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth, big upgrade) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest. Big moments deserve stronger feedback than routine ones: camera shake, a shockwave ring, or a larger popup. Mark milestones such as the first cube, the first affordable upgrade and tier-ups with a distinct presentation.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Luau parses a line that starts with `(` after a call or expression as a continuation, giving "Ambiguous syntax". Never start a statement with a parenthesis. Assign to a local first, or end the previous statement with `;`.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Bump an effect counter (sound, burst, popup) where the effect is really created, not where the remote is fired. If the counter is high but the census shows 0 sounds or bursts, the effects are not real or are destroyed before they are counted. Fix the effect, don't trust the counter.

```luau
--!strict
-- PadFeedbackFx: client-only presentation for buy pad affordability and denied-buy feedback.
-- Sends nothing to the server. ForgeTelemetry is a no-op on the client, so the
-- 'highlights' and 'pad_denied' counters are bumped by the server-side owner of these events.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local GameAssets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 10) :: ModuleScript) :: any
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme", 10) :: ModuleScript)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local GOOD = UiTheme.good
local BAD = UiTheme.bad

type State = {
	inst: Instance,
	part: BasePart,
	origColor: Color3,
	origMaterial: Enum.Material,
	highlight: Highlight?,
	label: TextLabel?,
	origTextColor: Color3?,
	origLabelSize: UDim2?,
	active: boolean,
	tweens: { Tween },
	flashToken: number,
}

local states: { [Instance]: State } = {}

local function resolvePart(inst: Instance): BasePart?
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return inst
	elseif inst:IsA("Model") then
		return inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	return nil
end

local function findLabel(inst: Instance, part: BasePart): TextLabel?
	local roots: { Instance } = { inst, part }
	if inst.Parent and inst.Parent ~= workspace then
		table.insert(roots, inst.Parent)
	end
	for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui") then
				return d
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function getState(inst: Instance): State?
	local existing = states[inst]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local part = resolvePart(inst)
	if not part then
		return nil
	end
	local hl = part:FindFirstChild("AffordHighlight")
	if not (hl and hl:IsA("Highlight")) then
		local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
		h.Name = "AffordHighlight"
		h.FillColor = GOOD
		h.OutlineColor = GOOD
		h.FillTransparency = 1
		h.OutlineTransparency = 1
		h.Adornee = part
		h.Parent = part
		hl = h
	end
	local label = findLabel(inst, part)
	local st: State = {
		inst = inst,
		part = part,
		origColor = part.Color,
		origMaterial = part.Material,
		highlight = hl :: Highlight,
		label = label,
		origTextColor = if label then label.TextColor3 else nil,
		origLabelSize = if label then label.Size else nil,
		active = false,
		tweens = {},
		flashToken = 0,
	}
	states[inst] = st
	return st
end

local function cancelTweens(st: State)
	for _, t in ipairs(st.tweens) do
		t:Cancel()
	end
	table.clear(st.tweens)
end

local function play(st: State, obj: Instance, info: TweenInfo, goal: { [string]: any })
	local t = TweenService:Create(obj, info, goal)
	table.insert(st.tweens, t)
	t:Play()
end

local function restore(st: State)
	cancelTweens(st)
	if st.part.Parent then
		st.part.Color = st.origColor
		st.part.Material = st.origMaterial
	end
	if st.highlight then
		st.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
		st.highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
	end
	if st.label then
		if st.origTextColor then
			st.label.TextColor3 = st.origTextColor
		end
		if st.origLabelSize then
			st.label.Size = st.origLabelSize
		end
	end
end

local function stopPulse(st: State)
	if not st.active then
		return
	end
	st.active = false
	restore(st)
end

local function startPulse(st: State)
	if st.active then
		return
	end
	st.active = true
	st.part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	if st.label then
		st.label.TextColor3 = GOOD
	end
	if st.highlight then
		st.highlight.FillColor = GOOD
		st.highlight.OutlineColor = GOOD
		st.highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
		local bright = st.origColor:Lerp(GOOD, 0.8)
		local dim = st.origColor:Lerp(GOOD, 0.25)
		local big = st.origLabelSize
		local grown = if big then UDim2.new(big.X.Scale * 1.1, big.X.Offset, big.Y.Scale * 1.1, big.Y.Offset) else nil
		while st.active and st.part.Parent do
			cancelTweens(st)
			play(st, st.part, info, { Color = bright })
			if st.highlight then
				play(st, st.highlight, info, { FillTransparency = 0.3 })
			end
			if st.label and grown then
				play(st, st.label, info, { Size = grown })
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not st.active then
				break
			end
			cancelTweens(st)
			play(st, st.part, info, { Color = dim })
			if st.highlight then
				play(st, st.highlight, info, { FillTransparency = 0.7 })
			end
			if st.label and big then
				play(st, st.label, info, { Size = big })
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

local function applyAffordable(inst: Instance)
	local st = getState(inst)
	if not st then
		return
	end
	if inst:GetAttribute("Affordable") == true then
		startPulse(st)
	else
		stopPulse(st)
	end
end

local watched: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}

local function watch(inst: Instance)
	if watched[inst] then
		return
	end
	if not (inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:IsA("Model")) then
		return
	end
	if inst:GetAttribute("Affordable") == nil then
		return
	end
	watched[inst] = true
	inst:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Affordable"):Connect(function()
		applyAffordable(inst)
	end)
	inst.Destroying:Connect(function()
		watched[inst] = nil
		local st = states[inst]
		if st then
			st.active = false
			cancelTweens(st)
			states[inst] = nil
		end
	end)
	applyAffordable(inst)
end

-- Toast
local toastLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local toastToken = 0

local function ensureToast(): TextLabel?
	if toastLabel and toastLabel.Parent then
		return toastLabel
	end
	local pg = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
	if not pg then
		return nil
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "PadFeedbackToast"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	l.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.22)
	l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.28, 0.08)
	l.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.cream
	l.TextColor3 = BAD
	l.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.Text = ""
	l.Visible = false
	UiTheme.roundify(l, UiTheme.cornerRadius)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	stroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	stroke.Parent = l
	l.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = pg
	toastLabel = l
	return l
end

local function showToast(text: string)
	local l = ensureToast()
	if not l then
		return
	end
	toastToken += 1
	local my = toastToken
	l.Text = text
	l.Visible = true
	l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.05)
	TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.28, 0.08),
	}):Play()
	task.delay(1.4, function()
		if toastToken == my and l.Parent then
			l.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

local function playBuzz()
	local candidates = { "error", "deny", "denied", "buzz", "fail", "wrong", "nope" }
	local sounds = GameAssets.Sounds
	if typeof(sounds) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(candidates) do
		if (sounds :: any)[name] ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				GameAssets.play(name, SoundService)
			end)
			return
		end
	end
end

local function flashRed(st: State)
	st.flashToken += 1
	local my = st.flashToken
	local wasActive = st.active
	if wasActive then
		stopPulse(st)
	end
	st.part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	st.part.Color = BAD
	task.delay(0.4, function()
		if st.flashToken == my and st.part.Parent and not st.active then
			st.part.Color = st.origColor
			st.part.Material = st.origMaterial
		end
	end)
end

local function findStateFor(obj: Instance?): State?
	local cur = obj
	while cur and cur ~= workspace do
		local st = states[cur]
		if st then
			return st
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	if obj then
		return getState(obj)
	end
	return nil
end

local function onDenied(pad: any, need: any)
	if typeof(pad) == "Instance" then
		local st = findStateFor(pad)
		if st then
			flashRed(st)
		end
		if typeof(need) ~= "number" then
			local c = pad:GetAttribute("Cost")
			if typeof(c) == "number" then
				need = c
			end
		end
	end
	playBuzz()
	if typeof(need) == "number" then
		showToast("Need $" .. tostring(math.floor(need)))
	else
		showToast("Not enough cash!")
	end
end

-- Hook up
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	watch(d)
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	-- attributes are usually set before parenting; defer so late setters are caught too
	task.defer(watch, d)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PadFeedback", 10)
	if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return
	end
	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: any, pad: any, need: any)
		if kind == "denied" then
			onDenied(pad, need)
		end
	end)
end)
```
